observations.text: The inner loop binds w with range(width), but the loop body never reads w.
The column coordinate uses ((i + width) % tiles_n), so every inner-loop iteration selects the same tile for a given i.
That same tile is cloned, permuted and appended once per inner-loop iteration; with the default width of 3, it is appended three times.

limits: Source inspection only; the quantizer was not executed.
Duplicating every sampled tile equally does not change an unweighted mean over the sample, but the runtime effect and intended sampling geometry were not measured.
The record is suspected because no contemporaneous contract establishes that width was required to select distinct neighboring columns.
